broken_cart.name: A wheel in the mud
broken_cart.text: The carter has unloaded the grain before the axle sinks. Two lengths of sound wood would brace the wheel long enough to reach the next village.

lost_traveler.name: A voice among the ferns
lost_traveler.text: A traveler followed an old trail mark into the trees. Walk slowly toward the marked road; they will follow your lantern.
lost_traveler.action: Lead the traveler to the road

road_ambush.name: Grain under guard
road_ambush.text: Oathbound sentries have stopped a small grain cart. Their order names a toll station that fell a century ago. Clear the road before speaking to the driver.

field_medicine.name: The empty medicine pouch
field_medicine.text: A road healer has enough clean water for a fever, but no herbs left. Three wild herbs will see the patient through the night.

warden_patrol.name: The patrol at the boundary
warden_patrol.text: A Warden patrol has stopped a caravan at an old boundary. The patrol leader will accept your witness that the travelers are carrying food.

veil_echo.name: A voice in the old stone
veil_echo.text: A damaged ward repeats the same unfinished sentence. Its keeper has become a hostile echo. Release it, then close the open circle.

rain_shelter.name: A fire out of the rain
rain_shelter.text: Two travelers are trying to light soaked kindling. A little dry timber from your pack would make this a place worth remembering.

lantern_vigil.name: The first free lanterns
lantern_vigil.text: The settlements have sent a lantern each to the crossing. No one has brought a ledger to count who owes whom. Stay long enough to light the last wick.
